title: Scripted locomotion runtime and stop transition
hypothesis: A deterministic scripted trajectory can drive the existing Stage2A kinematic-shell locomotion path with scalable forward speed and yaw while policy output remains live, and an explicit stop command can clear locomotion state and return to BalanceActive_Standing without resetting the bridge or actor.
single_behavior_change: Add a scripted locomotion composition method and a stop-to-standing method; do not change standing gains, action scales, model inputs, fixed timestep, root authority, or Physics Control tuning.
tdd_contract: Scripted locomotion is denied unless the existing Stage2A gate and policy-liveness conditions pass.
Intent magnitude is clamped to [0,1] and scales the existing 60 cm/s forward speed.
A supplied yaw delta is composed in the same scripted step as forward shell movement.
Trajectory conditioning can be explicitly suppressed for a later destructive-control product test while shell motion remains applied.
Stop clears intent and trajectory state, zeros accepted velocity, resets locomotion authority/request state, and returns to BalanceActive_Standing.
No CharacterMovement input API, SimRoot path, standing gain, or all-joint action scale is changed.
next_if_supported: Preregister E60 scripted causal locomotion product scenario with Normal, ZeroActions, DropTrajectoryConditioning, and SuppressStopTransition arms.
